scope: Manual offline MIDI-to-audio preparation of Berceuse recordings; not consumed by the app or catalog generator

preferredPiano.appliesTo: All Berceuse pieces when preparing MIDI-based replacement recordings
preferredPiano.feedback: The maintainer likes the new YDP variant B very much and selects it as the preferred piano voice for future Berceuse conversions.
preferredPiano.soundbank: YDP Grand Piano, FreePats SF2 version 2016-08-04, Yamaha Disklavier Pro
preferredPiano.soundbankCredits: Zenph Studios, Dr. Mikhail Krishtal and team; OLPC sound sample library / Dr. Richard Boulanger; SF2 and sample modifications by Roberto (roberto@zenvoid.org), FreePats

renderSettings.tempo: Retain each recording's chosen audition tempo through MIDI-event timing; do not impose the Burgmuller tempo on other pieces or stretch rendered audio
renderSettings.loudnessStrategy: Constant gain only; retain safe peak headroom and note dynamics; no compressor or limiter

preferredPiano.verification: Confirm actual reverb in the output using a wet/dry comparison. Earlier Salamander A/B renders were effectively identical because no MIDI reverb send reached the effect. Check loudness matching, full decoding, headroom, quiet ending and retained credits before delivering an audition.

additionalStrings.feedback: The maintainer likes the background fullness from strings but reports incorrect, late harmony changes, especially in the last third. They request correction across the entire piece. String accompaniment remains pending renewed listening approval; the YDP B piano preference is retained.
additionalStrings.audition: Burgmuller op. 109 No. 7: piano B with newly arranged held violin, viola and cello accompaniment; full-piece revision C2

revision.method: Review the full piano transcription's accompaniment notes and attacks, including dominant upper harmonies over tonic bass pedals and individual final-cadence changes. Do not infer an unchanged chord from a sustained bass alone. Gate each string note and its room response to silence before incompatible harmonic changes, retaining common tones only across compatible regions.
revision.validation: 37 full-piece harmonic regions, 127 compatible string-note/region intersections, paired MIDI events, full MP3 decode, matched loudness, peak headroom, quiet ending and matching local Nextcloud copies. This is structural verification against estimated piano notes, not a claim of error-free transcription or listening approval.

admissionBoundary: Piano-voice preference is not approval to replace any catalog recording or to promote an arrangement. Retain each specific source performance's recording license, attribution, modification disclosure and original files. Keep estimated original MIDI velocities separately from render-only softening. Complete recording-specific rights, audio-delivery, suitability and listening checks for each resulting recording before promotion.
